provenance.method: points: shapely representative_point() of each (multi)polygon in EPSG:3083, transformed to EPSG:4326 and rounded to 6 decimals; bounding boxes: shapely bounds of each (multi)polygon after transforming its vertices to EPSG:4326 (min_lat, min_lon, max_lat, max_lon), widened to include the point when an edge bows past the vertices, rounded to 6 decimals; districts: per plan, the district with the largest intersection area with the precinct in EPSG:3083 (ties to the lower number), share rounded to 4 decimals, split when share < 0.99, null when nothing overlaps
